source.title: Lifeless Stone Ring — Wowhead item page

quote: Infuse with the Essences of Azeroth to restore its power.
notes: Multi-reagent item-use conversion from the 2024 Radiant Echoes event; all three essences must be available together. The vendor sells the INPUT ring for 25 Residual Memories, not the output. Historical source; do not infer current event availability.
cost: 1x Essence of Northrend (223641), 1x Essence of Kalimdor (223643), and 1x Essence of the Eastern Kingdoms (223645); ring originally purchased for 25 Residual Memories
